text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: added can_pass(road_id, vehicle, network=None) to logistics/access.py — open roads allow any vehicle, restricted roads only light vehicles (vans), closed roads none, using the existing road_status validation. P2: added passable_route(warehouse_id, site, network=None) to logistics/routes.py, returning (route, vehicle) for the shortest usable route by (km, id) — truck when a truck may use every road, else van, or None — and rerouted_sites(network=None), which compares best_route and passable_route by route id only (vehicle-only changes don't count) and returns site ids in sorted order; best_route left unchanged. P3: added notify_rerouted(sites, day) to notifications/sms.py, queuing exactly one DELIVERY_MOVED text ({site}, {day}) per active household at those sites with sms_ok True, returning the queued messages; existing templates and queue_sms untouched. P4: distribution/planner.py build_plan now uses passable_route instead of best_route, setting route_id and vehicle from the (route, vehicle) tuple and keeping status 'unreachable' when None.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"]}}
